# id: PG-pg-85-balance-athletics
# covers: PG 193 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Beaks + Avarek)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 36D7474D+ (pg_statprobe), harness c5a5c88+ (give artifacts, research start any; 90a0e33: teleport moved=/bed, speed hold; 6933d0f: fill topup, drop all) (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: Avarek runs 40 m along +x on open ground 150 m from Beaks (harness swimtime on land: any axis, seconds
#   of game time), back to the start by teleport; also the game's movement speed (runspeed).
# verify: every point arrives (no 'did not arrive'); speed rises with Athletics; own50 > none = movement
#   reads the hooked Athletics.
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 4
speed 0
protect Beaks on
protect Avarek on
hunger Avarek 280
hunger Beaks 280
select Avarek
clearjobs Avarek
pg_statprobe on Avarek
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 150 ~ moved=1
water Avarek ~ water_level=none
give Avarek "Iron Hat" 1
equip Avarek "Iron Hat"
pg_info Avarek "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
# --- w1: skill 10, gear none ---
setstat Avarek athletics 10
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 150 ~ moved=1
speed 1 hold
@sleep 2
@set RS runspeed Avarek ~ (movement_speed=[\d.]+ .*ideal_run_speed=[\d.]+)
@set T swimtime Avarek 40 +x run ~ (swam [\d.]+ m seconds=[\d.]+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,193,athletics,10,0,none,w1,move,0,${T},${RS}
pg_statprobe read
# --- w2: skill 90, gear none ---
setstat Avarek athletics 90
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 150 ~ moved=1
speed 1 hold
@sleep 2
@set RS runspeed Avarek ~ (movement_speed=[\d.]+ .*ideal_run_speed=[\d.]+)
@set T swimtime Avarek 40 +x run ~ (swam [\d.]+ m seconds=[\d.]+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,193,athletics,90,0,none,w2,move,0,${T},${RS}
pg_statprobe read
# --- w3: skill 50, gear none ---
setstat Avarek athletics 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 150 ~ moved=1
speed 1 hold
@sleep 2
@set RS runspeed Avarek ~ (movement_speed=[\d.]+ .*ideal_run_speed=[\d.]+)

speed 0

pg_statprobe read
# --- w4: skill 50, gear own25 ---
setstat Avarek athletics 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Avarek "Iron Hat" athletics 25 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Avarek athletics ~ equipped_bonus=25% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
wake Avarek
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 150 ~ moved=1
